features.label: Two material options
features.text: Select the soft standard Doeskin comfort liner or the Sensil silicone-based grip liner for enhanced anti-migration during physical activity.

features.label: Compatible with unloader one x
features.text: Precision-cut replacement calf pads specifically designed for both the Standard and Short models of the Ossur Unloader One X knee brace.

features.label: Restores brace comfort
features.text: Replaces worn or flattened padding to improve daily wearability, ensure proper joint alignment, and prevent skin irritation.

measurement: Match the liner size (XS-M or LG-XL) and configuration (RL/LM or RM/LL) to your current Unloader One X brace specifications. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
